limitations: Read-only two-pass checks, not an atomic filesystem snapshot; atime is excluded from stat fingerprints.

The second remote pass returns only relative path/SHA256 metadata, not payload bytes. Actual maps are compared key-by-key locally before discarding the large transmitted map from this compact receipt.
Both original failed archive receipts and the prior en_US observation remain unchanged. No verifier edits, payload mutation, archive transfer, native replay, or result reclassification.

observation.full_pipeline: find . -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
